#The Cairn

The Ideal Masters were once mortal. They made themselves into something else, and the something else is hungry.

Every soul trapped in a black soul gem goes to them. Their realm is a waste of violet ash under a sky like a bruise, crowded with the souls they have collected.

#Its Keepers

The Keepers guard what the Masters prize. The Bonemen are the remains of soldiers. The Mistmen are what is left when even the bones are gone. The Wrathmen are angry about it.

The portal asks a toll of the living who enter the first time: a soul, in a gem. Pay it. The alternative is that it takes yours.
